responsibility: Implements GCC’s local RTL common subexpression elimination passes, operating mainly within extended basic blocks by value-numbering registers with quantity numbers and hashing canonicalized expressions. It records equivalent expressions and known constants, rewrites uses to cheaper equivalent regs or constants, simplifies jumps and condition-code handling, and provides the first, post-loop, and post-global-opts CSE pass entry points, with associated cleanup of dead insns, jump labels, and CFG after transformations.
